select p.*, sp.*, p.paid_content as paidContentJson from product p left join salesman_product sp on p.product_id = sp.product_id
p.is_delete = 0
and p.shop_id = #{pageQuery.shopId}
and (p.product_name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.productName}, '%') or p.product_sn like concat('%', #{pageQuery.productName}, '%'))
and p.product_status = #{pageQuery.status}
and (sp.is_join = 0 or sp.is_join is null)
and sp.commission_type = 2
and sp.is_join = 1
and sp.commission_type = 3

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id FROM product p LEFT JOIN translations_data t ON t.data_type = 2 AND t.data_id = p.product_id AND t.locale_id = ( SELECT l.id FROM locales l WHERE l.locale_code = #{localeCode} LIMIT 1 ) WHERE t.translation_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND p.product_status = 1 AND p.is_delete = 0

SELECT p.product_id FROM product p INNER JOIN ( SELECT td.translation_name, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN td.data_type = #{dataType} THEN td.id END), MIN(td.id)) AS translation_id FROM translations_data td WHERE td.locale_id = (SELECT l.id FROM locales l WHERE l.locale_code = #{localeCode} LIMIT 1) AND td.translation_value IS NOT NULL AND td.translation_value != '' GROUP BY td.translation_name ) names ON names.translation_name = p.product_name INNER JOIN translations_data displayed ON displayed.id = names.translation_id WHERE displayed.translation_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
